video.subject_count.evidence: [director·claude] 逐格数人，从头到尾是同样四个人：Riley、Felix、小男孩和母亲，没有分身，也没有多出来的人。小男孩 0.0 秒已经在画右边缘，母亲 0.75 秒从画右边缘走进来，两人都是从画框边上进出，不是凭空出现。母子 4.0–6.0 秒从 Riley 身边经过，6.25–7.75 秒走到画左，小男孩 8.0 秒走出画左，母亲 8.25 秒走出画左。8.5–10.75 秒画面里只剩 Felix 和走远的 Riley。Felix 一直站在石台后面。

video.no_text.evidence: [director·claude·审稿兜底，待机检工具] 所有 44 格只有审片工具加的黄色时间码。墙面、石台、门脸上都没有文字、字幕、水印、logo 或 UI，也没有像文字的刻痕。

video.object_continuity.evidence: [director·claude] 能跟住的道具都是连贯的。石台上的面包摞、托板和后面的石磨、砖炉火光一直都在，位置没跳。0.0–1.75 秒能看到 Riley 胯边挂着布包，后面各格没有布包凭空消失或悬空。Felix 2.0–2.25 秒抬手挥，之后双手回到台面上摆面包，手里的东西都从台面上来。6.0 秒母亲的长裙和 Riley 的腿在画面上叠在一起，从这一格看不出有没有穿模。备注：单个面包太小，拼图里数不出托板和那一摞各有几个，只能确认没有大件凭空增减。

video.person_still.evidence: [director·claude·审稿兜底，待机检工具] 没有人站成摆件。Riley 0–1.75 秒抬右手挥别，2.5–3.75 秒转身朝镜头走，4.0–5.75 秒站在街上，头先转向画右的母子再转回来，6.0–6.5 秒低头，6.75–7.75 秒把左臂往身侧伸出去，8.0 秒起朝画右走远。Felix 2.0–2.25 秒挥手，之后各格双手一直在台面上换位置摆面包。母子从 0.75 秒到 8.25 秒一直在走。

video.acting_natural.evidence: [Riley·claude] I judged only Riley (me). With the sound off, the shot reads like this: I say goodbye to the baker, step into the street, check which way to go, use my left hand to confirm 'left', and walk off to frame right without looking back. That matches the intended point. Beat by beat: 0.0–1.75s, I stand at the outer edge of the stone counter facing Felix, right hand at chest height waving to him; the wave is light and the size of an ordinary goodbye. 2.0–2.25s, Felix raises his hand to wave back and I'm still facing him; 2.5–2.75s, I turn and take two steps into the street. The turn starts less than 1s after his reply, so I'm reacting in time. 3.0–4.75s, I stand still on the street with my arms relaxed, facing the opposite side of the street, which reads as stopping to work out the direction. This is not a frozen stand-in: the stillness lasts under 2s, and my head and gaze shift a little. 5.0–5.5s, the mother and son walk past right beside me; my head turns toward frame right, toward them, for one glance, then comes back. That's how someone being pointed at by a passing child would react, and I don't make a bigger show of it than the moment calls for. 6.5–8.25s, I lower my gaze to my left hand and lift it out to my side (frame right), then hold that arm out toward frame right to check the direction. This lasts about 1.75s, roughly the same length as the spec's 5.8–7.2s beat, and doesn't drag. 8.5–10.75s, I turn toward frame right and walk off with big strides. My weight shifts and my arms swing naturally, and I walk with the confidence of having made up my mind, without looking back at the shop. I reacted on time at every beat and repeated no gag. Minor note: around 8.0–8.25s my outstretched left arm reads more like pointing than like holding the hand up at my side to look at it. It's still the same 'confirm left' beat and not a stiff pose, so I didn't mark it as an acting problem.；[Felix·claude] I'm judging only myself (Felix), the baker standing in the background behind the counter. 0–1.75s: my hands rest on the tray on the counter, I'm looking at Riley and smiling, and I stay quiet while she raises her hand and starts waving (cells 0.0–1.75). That's how I'd see off a customer, not like a prop. 2.0–2.25s: I raise my right hand high and wave once (cells 2.0 and 2.25), within about 1 second of her wave. My reaction is on time and not bigger than the moment; I'm just answering her goodbye. 2.5s: my hand comes down, and from 2.75s I'm looking down at the tray and working. 4.0–5.75s: I lean forward and reach right, moving bread from the tray onto the pile (cells 4.5–5.25 clearly show my arm reaching). 6.0–8.75s: I keep my head down arranging bread; the mother and son pass in front of the counter, and at 7.0–7.75 they block me for a while, but my hands never stop. That fits 'I keep working while I see her off,' with no frozen pauses. 9.0–9.75s: I lift my head and face forward with my hands still on the bread. 10.0–10.75s: I lower my head again to place the bread. At no point am I frozen or still, I don't repeat a gag, and I don't put on a big expression the moment doesn't call for. Small note: in cells 9.0–10.25 the grid is too small to make out the slight smile and the light head shake, or to tell whether my eyes follow her toward the right side of the frame. But what I can see (lifting my head briefly, then going back to work) doesn't overplay anything, so this doesn't count as an acting problem.

video.point_landed.evidence: [director·claude] 关掉声音能看出来的是：Riley 在石台前挥手告别（0–1.75 秒），面包师挥手回应（2.0–2.25 秒）。她走到街上站住，看了看两头（3.0–5.75 秒），低头之后把左手往身侧伸出去确认（6.0–7.75 秒），然后果断朝画右大步走远（8.0–10.75 秒）。面包师一直在低头摆面包。看点的前半段（她用左手认准方向，信心满满地走了）看得出来，节奏也像真人。但看点的落点是：她走远时 Felix 抬头，嘴角一动，轻轻摇一下头（9.4–10.2 秒）。9.0–10.75 秒每格里 Felix 的脸只有十来个像素，每秒又只有 4 帧，分不出他有没有抬头、有没有摇头。所以这个落点能不能让观众看懂，从拼图判断不了。另外，10.75 秒 Riley 还在画右边缘，没有完全走出画面。
